subject.title: fix(line): record every LINE push message id in send receipts

question: Should the shared outbound receipt contract accept the additive optional per-result `kind` seam used to preserve distinct LINE media and caption kinds?
rationale: The mechanical LINE fix is coherent, but this modifies a shared receipt input contract consumed across channel adapters; its long-term API boundary should be confirmed by the reviewer who requested the invariant.

options.title: Approve the additive receipt seam
options.body: Accept the optional per-result kind as the generic way for adapters to preserve per-physical-message receipt kinds, subject to current-head live proof and base refresh.

options.title: Keep the contract LINE-local
options.body: Ask for a narrower LINE-local construction only if the shared normalizer should remain limited to one aggregate kind per flat result.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive receipt seam
recommendation.body: Accept the optional per-result kind as the generic way for adapters to preserve per-physical-message receipt kinds, subject to current-head live proof and base refresh.
